root_cause: Diagnosed LIVE on the stand (ooo-akson tenant, real Keycloak token for ivanov-i, real Postgres :55432). Same user, same token: GET /api/records/:id of a 'clients' record ivanov CREATED → 404; GET of a 'supplier' record → 200; LIST clients count=0, LIST supplier count=1; DELETE clients → 403. The asymmetry is NOT the T-0619 role-reader grant: role-reader confers read/record on the RESOURCE_ROOT sentinel, which the composite resource-ancestry oracle (src/db/resource-ancestry.ts rule 2) treats as covering EVERY record in the tenant — universal across all apps, and ivanov-i HOLDS a confirmed role-reader assignment (verified by SQL). The real cause is the T-0558 SANDBOX GATE keyed on application.tier: apps 'clients'/'catalog-items' are tier='draft', apps 'supplier'/'budget-item'/'purchase-request' are tier='published'. src/http/records.ts sandboxReadPredicate hides draft-tier records from a caller who is not owner/admin and holds no authoring_draft grant (ivanov-i: is_owner=f, authoring_draft=f, proven by SQL). But POST /api/records (createRecord) has NO tier gate — a non-privileged user CAN write a record into a draft-tier app, then can neither read it back (GET 404 / list empty) nor delete it (DELETE required owner/admin|authoring_draft). Net: a user creates an object invisible AND undeletable to themselves — a столп-4 (rights-circuit) break. Classification: DATA (app tiers) + a create/read-consistency gap in code (create not sandbox-gated while read/delete are).

fix_summary.creator_own_floor: src/core/sandbox-gate.ts sandboxReadPredicate gains an OPTIONAL creatorEscape { ownerColumn, ownerParam }. For a non-privileged actor the sandbox restriction becomes ( <tierColumn> = 'published' OR <ownerColumn> = <ownerParam> ) instead of published-only — so the actor keeps sight of records they created themselves even in a draft-tier app. The actor slug is passed as a BOUND $N param (never inlined as a literal — the only caller-derived value in the fragment); tierColumn/ownerColumn are trusted code-level constants. Omitting creatorEscape yields the byte-identical pre-T-0623 fragment (no behavioral change for callers that don't opt in). The pure module stays IO-free (no new imports) so tier-isolation/floor2-sandbox-isolation stay green.
fix_summary.records_read_paths: src/http/records.ts LIST (listRecordsPaginated) and GET-by-id (getRecordDetail) now pass creatorEscape = { ownerColumn: 'r.created_by', ownerParam: <bound $N> } with the resolved actor slug bound as a param, but ONLY for a non-privileged actor (privileged already sees all tiers). This is additive AND — never relaxes the tenant scope (withTenantTx + RLS + the explicit r.tenant_id guard are untouched) and never reveals another actor's draft row.
fix_summary.records_delete_authz: src/http/records.ts DELETE: the route no longer 403s every non-privileged actor up front. It resolves config privilege (owner/admin | authoring_draft) and passes actorIsConfigPrivileged into deleteRecord, which enforces the ownership floor INSIDE the FOR UPDATE locked read (atomic, no TOCTOU): a config-privileged actor may delete ANY record; a non-privileged actor may delete ONLY a record they created (created_by = actor), else { forbidden } → 403. Existence is confirmed first so a non-existent id stays an honest 404 (never a 403 that would leak existence).

invariants_preserved.tenant_isolation: The creator escape matches only the actor's OWN resolved slug within their OWN tenant (RLS + r.tenant_id). Live-proved on the stand: the fixed predicate with created_by='sidorov-s' returns 0 rows for ivanov's draft record; cross-tenant B rows remain invisible (DB test 'TENANT ISOLATION preserved').
invariants_preserved.field_visibility: Unchanged — applyFieldVisibilityRedaction is a separate composite gate applied on top of the sandbox/record-read gates; not touched.
invariants_preserved.read_pdp: Unchanged — role-reader (covering read/record grant) is still required; isRecordReadable still runs after the sandbox filter. A user WITHOUT role-reader still gets 404. The fix only relaxes the SANDBOX overlay for the creator's own records, never the PDP grant math (grant-lattice.ts / read-visibility.ts untouched).
